component.name: Note Note
component.summary: Edit local Markdown notes and connected notebooks

description.p: Note Note brings local Markdown notebooks, Microsoft OneNote, Sticky Notes, and Notion into one workspace. Local notebooks work without an account.
Organize notebooks in tabs, search notes, and edit rich text with Markdown storage. The application follows available desktop colors and saves changes before closing.

screenshot.caption: Notebook tabs, note list, and rich text editing

description.p: OneNote's hourly request limit lasts longer on pages with lists. Microsoft's limit counts only OneNote's own requests, and Note Note now counts them the same way: the OneDrive and OneNote web requests that list editing and page ordering need are paced on their own. Opening a page with lists uses one OneNote request instead of six, and indenting a list item three instead of fifteen.
Right-click a OneNote section and choose Refresh to list its pages again at once. It is greyed out for half a minute after you reorder that section's pages, while OneNote catches up.

OneNote content search reads pages slowly in the background, one at a time, so it no longer uses up OneNote's hourly request limit. Pages you open or save count as read, and the open page's check uses fewer requests.

Nested numbered lists in OneNote keep their nesting, a list made in a table cell can be saved, and a blank line next to a list can be removed. A page whose list levels OneNote does not return opens read-only instead of failing.

Indenting a list item joins the list already at that level, and a paragraph indented with it is indented like any other paragraph. A local note with an HTML table or list the editor cannot show opens as read-only source. Deleting a OneNote section no longer brings back pages that could not be created in it.

Bullets and numbered lists have styles: the arrow next to each list button offers ●, ○ and ◾ bullets, and 1, a, A, I and i numbering. Tab indents a list item and Shift+Tab outdents it, also in a table cell; each level takes the next style, and returning to a level continues its numbering. Local notes and OneNote keep the styles; OneNote saves an indented item as the same item, with its children and formatting.
Closing the window puts it away at once. Changes still being saved finish in the background, and opening Note Note again meanwhile brings the window back.
OneNote pages can be dragged into order right after the app opens and while an earlier order is still saving. New and deleted OneNote sections show at once.
Renaming asks for the new name in the name dialog. A local folder renamed and renamed back no longer loses the open note's saves.
Fewer false conflicts when a list is split while blank lines are removed or text is added, and fewer OneNote requests when reordering pages.
Right-click a note to delete it; the × on each note is gone. Right-click a section to make a section inside it, rename it or delete it.

Folders inside a local notebook are now its sections, to any depth, listed before its notes and folded until you open them. A notebook's own tab has a New section button, and New section asks for the name in a small dialog, in OneNote too.

OneNote sections can be renamed and deleted in personal notebooks you can edit. The new name shows at once, and a deleted section goes to the OneDrive recycle bin. With all OneNote notebooks in one tab, New section moved from the footer to each notebook's right-click menu.
Notebook and section rows show how many notes they hold.

A title you type shows in the note list at once, instead of after the note is saved. With OneNote, which takes a few seconds to save, the list no longer lags behind the title, also when you move to another note before the save is done.
A note you change and change back — a space typed and deleted, a word undone — is no longer saved again, so it costs no OneNote or Notion request.

Content Note Note cannot edit is no longer lost when you save. A local note with HTML, nested quotes or a list inside a quote, a Notion page with block colours or code captions, and a OneNote page with superscript or subscript now open read-only and say why. Underlining or bolding part of a word saves. A table or picture pasted into a notebook that cannot store it goes in as plain text.

OneNote and Notion saves no longer repeat a paragraph or a page when the service is slow to answer, and a Notion save no longer overwrites changes made in Notion since the page was opened. A conflict review stays open when the window is hidden. Sign-out says when it could not remove a credential. Notes saved with Windows line endings keep their title, and OneNote sections created recently can be reordered again.

Page ordering and blank-line removal work in personal OneNote notebooks shared with you for editing, not only in your own. Signing in to OneNote now includes the OneDrive permission they need. An older sign-in asks you to sign in again once, and unsaved changes are kept.

Blank lines in OneNote pages can now be deleted, or typed on. OneNote gives them nothing an app can edit, so such a save failed and kept its draft. Note Note now removes them the way OneNote's web app does, in personal notebooks you own with page ordering enabled.
Insert → Diacritics offers the accented letters of your region, found from the system timezone, such as Romanian ă â î ș ț.

OneNote pages can be reordered by dragging them, in personal notebooks you own. Choose Enable page ordering… once to give the app the OneDrive permission this needs. Subpages show indented under their page and move with it. The new order is saved to OneNote, and a save that fails puts the pages back where they were.

Local notes can be dragged within each notebook when all notebooks share one tab, too. Escape cancels a drag, holding a note at the top or bottom of the list scrolls it, and a quick drag moves the note instead of scrolling the list.

A new OneNote page opens for typing at once, before OneNote has made it, and what you type is saved to the page as soon as it exists. Deleting a note removes it immediately and opens the next one; if OneNote refuses the delete, the note comes back in its place with any unsaved text. A page OneNote could not create keeps its text until you copy it elsewhere and delete it, even across a sign-out.

OneNote audio recordings, including phone recordings, play inline with a round Play/Stop button and a seek bar. A recording is downloaded only when you press Play, so opening a page stays fast, and notes with recordings can be edited, copied and pasted without losing them. Qt Multimedia is optional: without it notes still open and edit.

The editing tools stay on one horizontally scrollable row in narrow windows, with Insert fixed on the right. Notebook tabs and workspace controls have refined rounded shapes, and the status bar has a larger left-panel icon for showing or hiding the sidebar.
Fix bold text returning after saving and reopening a note. Turning Bold off now saves regular text while keeping other inline formatting.
Fix notes remaining Unsaved when an indented line contains pasted inline code or other formatting. Tabs and leading spaces now preserve prose indentation and formatting when the note is saved.

OneNote discovers shared notebook links and resumes notebook and page discovery after a restart or request-budget pause, keeping capacity available for opening and saving notes. An unused local notes folder starts with a Getting started note, and light themes have clearer text and active tabs.

Images now have a small, consistent gap before the following text, regardless of their size. The title bar and notebook header share the sidebar surface, while the formatting toolbar matches the editor.

The editing toolbar offers only the tools that apply where the caret is. Inside a code block the text styles, text color, highlight, link, headings, lists, indent and quote are hidden, instead of typing Markdown markers into the code; in a table cell the heading, indent, outdent, quote and code block tools are hidden.
The note's scrollbar sits just beside the note instead of over its right edge, so it no longer covers text or code blocks.

Plugins can add editing-toolbar tools that insert or format text in the note; the Insert month tools now come from the built-in calendar plugin. Tool popups such as Insert link and Insert custom month are lighter: a small header, fields without labels above them, and a footer with the key hint beside one Insert button. Escape or a click outside cancels.
The note's scrollbar stays visible whenever the note is longer than the window, not only while the mouse is over it, and a note that fits shows none.

Undo puts the cursor back where the edit began: undoing a paste, a highlight, a color, a list or a block tool no longer jumps to the top or the end of the note. Ctrl+Y now redoes on Linux desktops too.
Fix undo moving the cursor back toward a table after editing text below it. Table formatting now initializes when the note loads.

Review fixes since 1.0.21. The status bar's sidebar toggle is quiet until hovered and the status message shows the link under the pointer. OneNote refuses a save that would flatten formatting and keeps sections in their owner's order; a Notion page opens for editing only when a save can put it back; a cut Sticky note opens read-only. Pasting says why it did nothing, headings four to six survive the editor, and every network response is read through one bounded, deadline-aware reader.
Local Markdown notebooks, OneNote, Sticky Notes and Notion in one workspace, available as a Linux app and an Omarchy plugin.
Switch directly to notebook tabs with Alt+1 through Alt+9.
Add the standalone Qt application, system colors, and safe shutdown while background reads are active.
